| #### Scorching Heat / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Hotter Still. You gain a +2 bonus to fire damage you deal. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th levels / Fuel to the flame. When you deal Wind or Fire Damage to a creature with ranks of Burned, you convert 1 rank of Burned a creature has to 1 rank of Immolation. / Scorch Magnification. You can spend Scorch Charges to use the Scorch effect of Shakuton Hijutsu you cast. |

A Genin dashes through a thick brush of trees trying to escape an ambush. She weaves hand seals and Fires forth a white-hot sphere of flame towards the brush in front of her, completely burning way the brush in front of him without even a hint of smoke or soot. As they move through the forest chasing her, they arrive to an opening in the forest. Seeing their target, they move in to attack, but she responds by conjuring a large, single sphere of Scorch flame and engulf all of her enemies, turning them into mummified carcasses.

—Soren Uzumaki

At Worlds End, Ch. 2 excerpt.

Too Hot to Touch

The Shakuton Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Wind. This clan has an extreme affinity for Fire & Wind Release able to create flames as hot as a small sun that can burn away all moisture on impact. This clan has a famed history in the Land of Wind, but after one of its famed members were killed in an ambush, they scattered joining other villages to avoid the potential of a clan massacre.

Shakuton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Survival, Ninshou.

Scorch Release Affinity: You begin with either Wind or Fire Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Scorch Release Techniques: The Shakuton Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: The Shakuton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Blazing Heat Regulation: Shakuton Clansmen and creatures within 5 feet of them are immune to hostile cold environments and do not need to make checks or saving throws to resist effects caused by extreme cold temperatures.

Shakuton Features

Heating Up

1st Level Clan Feature

Your chakra is hotter, more dangerous, and more lethal than any other user of fire release, not because you are inherently stronger, no. It’s because you can directly infuse and feed your flames with wind release, constantly increasing the potency and heat of your flames until they emulate that of a small sun, reacting to the fuel you feed it. Beginning at 1st level, each time you cast a Shakuton Clan Hijutsu or a jutsu with the Fire or Wind Release keyword, you build heat, increasing your temperature to the extreme. This is represented as Scorch Charges of which, you can gain 1, once per turn when you cast the qualifying jutsu. You can maintain up to 2 Scorch Charges at a time and they are dispelled after 1 minute. You cannot gain Scorch Charges the same turn you spend them as a result of casting a jutsu. While you have Scorch Charges you are in your Scorching Heat state.

When you reach 3rd, 7th, 11th and 15th levels, increase the maximum Scorch Charges you can maintain by +2.

Desiccated Heat

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your flames go beyond just burning. They can boil, dehydrate, evaporate and even melt without leaving so much as a burn mark. But you can control it. Make it far less about burning, and more versatile in nature, based on your needs in the moment, by spending your Scorch Charges. If an ability requires a saving throw or makes an attack, use your highest jutsu ability modifier/saving throw DC. Select two abilities. You gain an additional 2 options at 11th level.

Scorching Aura

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to generate a zone of intense heat for all creatures within 20-feet of you. This zone of intense heat is not only uncomfortable, but also detrimental. Creatures other than you within the zone cannot regain hit points while within the zone. If a creature would regain hit points while within the affected area, they instead take Fire damage equal to the amount of hit points they would regain. This fire damage is treated as if you dealt the damage to them.

This zone lasts until the end of your next turn, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to extend this auras duration by 1 round.

Blazing Aura

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to generate a zone of blazing heat for all creatures within 20-feet of you. This zone of heat is painful to be within for all creatures, excluding you. Creatures other than you that begin their turn within the zone or enter the zone for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Immolation. Increase the damage this aura deals by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels and the ranks of Immolation inflicted by +1 at 11th level.

This zone lasts until the end of your next turn, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to extend this auras duration by 1 round.

Dehydrating Aura

| Desiccated Heat – Immolation / [Elemental], Max Ranks: 5 / An Immolated created takes 1d12 fire damage at the start of each of their turns for each rank it has. / An Immolated creature can concentrate on one less jutsu while under this affliction. / Creatures that are immune to fire damage is immune to this condition. / An Immolated creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to generate a zone of intense and evaporating heat for all creatures within 20-feet of you. This zone of heat is difficult to be within for all creatures, excluding you. Creatures other than you that begin their turn within the zone or enter the zone for the first time on a turn must make a Wisdom saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failed save. Increase the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1 at 11th level.

This zone lasts until the end of your next turn, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to extend this auras duration by 1 round.

Instigating Blaze

When an allied creature within 60 feet of you, excluding yourself, casts a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu that doesn’t have both the Wind and Fire Release keywords, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to overheat it, granting the jutsu both keywords and the following bonuses:

Their Jutsu’s damage increases by +2 Damage die, but this additional damage is fire damage.

Their Jutsu reduces the affected creatures Temporary Hit points to 0, before calculating the damage dealt.

Swirling heat

When you or an allied creature within 60 feet of you triggers the Swirl effect on a Jutsu with the Wind Release keyword, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge turning the swirling wind into a blazing twister. Increase the radius of the Swirl to a 10-foot radius on the affected creature and all creatures in the area instead gain 1 rank of Immolation.

Searing Knuckle

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, coat your hands or feet in scorching flames that only harms what you touch for the next minute. Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 2d6, deals fire damage, and if you score a critical hit while dealing [Unarmed Damage], the target gains 1 rank of Immolation.

Additionally, as an Action, by placing your hand against plant matter or something metallic, that is no larger than a 1-foot cube, you are able to reduce it to ash or a molten puddle by flash frying it.

Searing Edge

As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, to coat either your own or an allied creatures weapon in a super-heated layer of scorching flames for the next minute. The affected weapons [Weapon Damage] becomes 1d12, deals fire damage, and if you score a critical hit while dealing [Weapon Damage], the target gains 1 rank of Immolation.

Heat Mirage

As an Action, you release pent up heat, creating a hazy wave of heat that creates optical illusion making it hard to adequately select a target. All creatures in a 30-Foot Cone originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw, gaining 2 ranks of Dazzled on a failure.

Creatures with ranks of Immolation that make this saving throw, do so suffering a -1 penalty to their saving throws for each rank of Immolation it has.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Scorch Release

7th Level Clan Feature

The Shakuton clan has a unique talent for manifesting Scorch Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Fire release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Scorch Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Fire or Wind Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Fire respectively.

Additionally, As an action, you can evaporate all exposed sources of water or ice, no larger than a 10-foot cube that you can touch, boiling them into steam in an instant.

Evaporating Barrier

11th Level Clan Feature

The Shakuton clan has the ability to destroy moisture on a molecular level. If you would clash with a jutsu by spending 1 Scorch Charge, the opposing creature, makes their check with a -4 penalty to their result. If you succeed the clash check, the opposing creature also gains ranks of Weakened based on the rank of the Jutsu you originally cast. (D-Rank: 1 Rank, C-Rank: 2 Ranks, B-Rank: 3 Ranks, A-Rank: 4 Ranks, S-Rank: 5 Ranks.)

If the opposing creature clashed with a jutsu with the Water or Wind Release keywords, then as part of this feature, you make your check at advantage and apply an equal number of ranks of Immolation as Weakened on a successful clash.

Scorching Dominion

15th Level Clan Feature

You have reached the peak of the Shakuton clans ability to generate heat and fire. You gain the following abilities;

You can generate Scorch Charges up to twice per turn now.

You are always in your Scorching Heat state, even without Scorch Charges.

While a creature is within 20 feet of you with the Immolation or Burned condition, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge to increase or decrease the ranks of that condition by 1. Once you do this, you cannot do it again until the end of your next turn.

Once per turn, while a creature is within 20 feet of you with the Chilled condition, you can reduce the ranks of Chilled they have by 2, by spending 1 Scorch Charge.
